Desperate to save his comatose lover from a nightmare overdose, ex-dream auditor Malek takes a job breaking into the city’s Dream Vault, | where nightmare smugglers lure him into a deadly underworld that trades in stolen sleep and fractured psychic memories.

When the taxman seizes his most sacred childhood dream as payment for mounting debts, jaded bartender Nico infiltrates an underground nightmare market, | risking his sanity to recover it from a cartel kingpin haunted by his own worst fears.

Tasked with erasing illicit fantasies, government dream-censor Val Kovach discovers a whisper network of artists trafficking illegal nightmares, | and faces an impossible choice between allegiance to the regime or freedom for his tormented, addicted brother.

Gideon, the eldest son in an ancient line of clockmakers, must confront his guilt after accidentally causing his brother's death in the workshop, | as their family's magical hour-rewind comes with crippling consequences that threaten to shatter their bond forever.

When reserved clockmaker Tomas is begged by a grieving widow to rewind her husband's fatal accident, he risks exposing his family's secret to the suspicious townsfolk, | all while wrestling with his own forbidden love for the deceased man's son.

Struggling to keep the family business alive in a neon-lit city, clockmaker Leon must decide whom to save when a mafia boss demands the rewind power after a bloody shootout, | testing Leon's loyalty to both kin and conscience as vengeance ticks ever closer.

After losing all recollection of his childhood, wandering sailor Cassian ventures into the fabled marketplace of Estrel on Whisper Isle, desperate to barter away new, painful memories for traces of his forgotten past | as mysterious traders offer him their darkest enchantments in exchange for the secrets he still carries unknowingly within.

When destitute fisherman Mateo is coerced into selling his happiest memory to pay his dying brother’s medical debt, the island’s enchanting vendors circle hungrily, | tempting him with dangerous magical bargains that could save his brother’s life but cost Mateo his very identity.

Haunted by memories he cannot escape, exiled magician Silas attempts to purchase a forbidden spell from the Veil Market to erase his guilt, | but in this marketplace where memories fuel every trade, the sinister merchant recognizes the true horrors Silas hopes to forget.

Detective Theo Marrow uses his rare gift to relive victims' final emotions in rain-soaked 1980s Chicago, tracking a serial killer whose last victims all felt nothing but pure euphoria, | baffled by how bliss precedes such violent ends and drawing the suspicion of both his colleagues and the killer himself.

Haunted by the inability to save his wife, hard-edged detective Rafe experiences the terror of murdered socialites in the neon-lit clubs of Miami, | each crime immersing him deeper in their panic, until one woman's final, shameful longing threatens to unravel both his sanity and the case.

In a small, corrupt town, detective Leon Granger risks his life by stepping into the suffocating rage left behind by a murdered politician, | realizing the emotion wasn’t the victim’s but her killer’s—and that the killer now stalks Leon from the shadows, intent on silencing his investigation.

In a neon-lit city where every child is assigned a unique alien companion for psychological development, teenage Milo’s symbiotic partner begins urging him to sabotage the annual Companion Purge, | as he uncovers disturbing truths behind the government’s control of childhood imaginations.

Sixteen-year-old Tavi is tormented at school for his bizarre, venomous insectoid companion and starts an underground group for outcasts, | but their secret meetings catch the attention of authorities who declare their imaginary friends dangerously autonomous.

Assigned a hulking, mysterious alien as his imaginary friend, orphaned Ezra is forced into therapy after the companion starts manifesting in violent dreams, | driving him to seek out his birth parents who may have ties to the alien race itself.

After a citywide accident wipes his identity from every official record, Ezra boards a midnight train that materializes on the tracks whenever he searches for answers, | and the shadowy conductor demands the price of a memory for each stop along their spectral journey.

Struggling with amnesia after a mysterious alleyway encounter, Kaspar follows eerie whistles echoing through the foggy outskirts to a derelict train station, | where ghostlike passengers beckon him to recall what he’s lost—or risk vanishing into the between-world forever.

Haunted by trauma that caused everyone to forget his existence, Viktor leaps onto a phantom train that snakes beneath the city, | but each passing car forces him to relive his darkest secrets in front of a crowd of silent, faceless riders.

When exiled chef Marco Cassini is pressured by the dictator’s son to cater a crucial political gala, he must decide whether to use his secret recipe that can sway loyalties for a day, | knowing that a single taste could ignite rebellion or seal his own execution.

Haunted by the memory of his vanished lover, renegade chef Dmitri smuggles his mind-altering cuisine into the heart of Parliament during regime change negotiations, | risking assassination from spies who suspect his powers and hope to use—or destroy—him before midnight.

In a war-torn city where allegiances shift daily, street cook Salvio crafts meals that temporarily reshape beliefs, | but when the resistance captures his estranged brother and demands their liberation through his forbidden dishes, Salvio faces a harrowing personal and ethical dilemma.

Beneath the pulsing ribcage of a slumbering titan, disgraced knight Calen schemes to overthrow the corrupt heart-chamber king, | all while the titan occasionally shifts, threatening to crush their entire world at the slightest touch.

After hearing whispers that the titan’s dreaming mind can be reached through its bloodstream, a desperate smuggler infiltrates the forbidden Vein District to save his brother, | risking insanity and death at the hands of bloodborne zealots who worship the titan as a god.

Edran, a young surgeon’s apprentice, uncovers a grotesque conspiracy involving the royal family harvesting the titan’s marrow for black market magic, | forcing him to choose between exposing the secret or protecting the woman he loves from a monstrous fate.

Commander Aleksandr wakes in orbit to find bioluminescent vines threading themselves through the ship’s controls, threatening the survival of his crew, | as whispered voices in the air vents tempt him to betray his human companions for a terrifying organic unity.

Tasked with charting a distant nebula, Lieutenant Marco DeLuca stumbles upon a shimmering micro-forest colonizing the engineering bay, its fungal nodes pulsing with a heartbeat synchronized to his own, | and he must choose between eradicating the lifeform or letting it evolve, even as it starts warping his memories and desires.

As medical officer Grant Meller treats strange rashes spreading across his body and those of his crewmates, he realizes the ship’s walls are yielding flesh-like growths that react to his touch, | spurring him to uncover the ecosystem’s origins before his repressed traumas become physical realities stalking the corridors.

When widowed blacksmith Tomas discovers every mirror in his isolated village reveals a drastically different version of his life, he agonizes over whether to pursue the reflection where his late wife is still alive, | while disturbing visions hint that meddling with these alternate selves may irreparably fracture his mind.

Haunted by the choices he never made, reclusive schoolteacher Pavel cannot resist peering into the village’s mirrors, each revealing an alternate existence where he’s rich, infamous, or in prison, | and the temptation grows as a mysterious mirror begins to predict, rather than reflect, his upcoming actions.

After surviving a near-fatal accident, jaded bartender Luka becomes obsessed with the mirror in his tavern that shows him an adulterous criminal; consumed by paranoia, he fears his doppelganger's vices will begin to bleed into reality, | especially as villagers whisper that Luka is changing in ways even he cannot explain.

Every night a fierce storm lashes Port Graham, where local fisherman Caleb reels in possessions that seem linked to missing townsfolk, | and one morning he finds a bloodstained wedding dress with his own name stitched inside the collar.

Haunted by his father's disappearance during childhood, reclusive sand sculptor Jonah sifts the storm-tossed debris for clues on the lonely beach, | until he uncovers a familiar locket bearing a message about a future he was never meant to inherit.

When handsome bartender Lucas finds a sealed letter forecasting a stranger's suicide among the wrack, guilt drives him to stalk each new arrival in town, | terrified that the next storm will force him to confront someone he must choose to save or condemn.

Facing trial for a murder he does not remember committing, disgraced lawyer Simon Kroll is stunned as childhood friends he had long since forgotten appear one by one as witnesses, | their testimonies inexplicably weaving memories he cannot recall into a damning narrative that may seal his fate.

Accused of corporate espionage, tech prodigy Marcus finds himself in a surreal courtroom where every witness is a twisted echo of his lonely childhood acquaintances, | each revealing unsettling secrets Marcus thought buried forever, forcing him to confront the past he tried desperately to erase.

When war veteran Jack Mallory stands accused of a crime committed during blackout drunkenness, the court summons spectral versions of boys from his troubled youth as witnesses, | exposing the darkest layers of his psyche and threatening to unravel his fragile sense of innocence and guilt.

Dr. Rowan Mears, an ambitious botanist assigned to a remote Arctic research station, discovers that his colleagues’ secrets trigger the blooming of ominous black irises, | leaving him uncertain who he can trust when a murder investigation begins among the snowbound team.

Trapped by a violent storm, field director Max Brogan must conceal both a dangerous international scandal and his affair with a rival scientist, | as each denial causes the rare truthblooms in the greenhouse to unfurl, threatening to expose him to the entire compound.

After inheriting his brother’s post at the clandestine Verdancy Station, forensic botanist Will Gedeon realizes the flowers react more violently to his own fabrications, | causing suspicion among the crew and forcing Will to confront the reason his sibling vanished without trace.

Jasper, the brooding ringmaster cursed to trail his roaring lion’s shadow forever, struggles to break free as the circus crosses into a dying desert town, | when a mysterious local woman offers him a grim bargain to lift the curse at terrible personal cost.

Haunted by the shadowy echo of his knife-throwing act, illusionist Varek finds his spectral doppelganger sabotaging performances, | until one night a child disappears between the shadows and he becomes the main suspect hunted by the entire troupe.

The fallen acrobat Silas, forced to relive his fatal tumble nightly in the circus’s echoing tent, attempts to defy his spectral torment, | but the ringleader’s seductive shadow lures him deeper toward a dark truth about the troupe’s eternal punishment.

A battle-scarred mapmaker named Harun is ordered by his empress to journey through haunted jungles charting borders marked by roving swarms of dragon-sized bees, facing sabotage from traitorous nobles within his caravan, | as each shifting migration threatens to wipe out villages and redraw imperial claims before his ink dries.

When Varek, a disgraced imperial beekeeper, is coerced to reclaim his honor by riding atop a colossal queen bee across a volatile border, sinister rebel factions try to intercept him mid-flight, | forcing him to decide between saving his lover among the rebels or obeying the crown’s ruthless decree.

Tolben, a cynical tax collector, is tasked with extorting devastated frontier hamlets only during the bees’ migration season, navigating both his deadly fear of the insects and the wrath of starving peasants, | while a hidden plague spreads among the bee colonies threatening the empire’s very foundation.

Captain Milo Reyes salvages his own corpse from a twisted wreck on the edge of a collapsing nebula, forcing him to confront memories of his failed marriage and haunting choices, | as ghostly whispers echo in the ruined hull and the wrecked ship’s logs hint at murder.

Engineer Galen Chen uncovers a derelict vessel in deep space with logs detailing a version of his life where he betrayed his crew, leaving him torn between confessing and hiding the truth, | as fragments of alternate fates multiply with every distress beacon answered.

Navigator Rael stumbles upon a massive graveyard of ships—each belonging to another him doomed by a seductive alien benefactor, | forcing him to weigh loyalty against desperate temptation in a battle where his crew’s trust begins to unravel.

Brother Gavril, a devout monk renowned for his emotional stoicism, is assigned to safeguard the reliquary containing Lust after a series of unexplained breakages, | forcing him to confront his own repressed desires as an alluring novice arrives at the monastery.

Tasked with cataloguing forbidden reliquaries beneath the snowbound monastery, Father Marius uncovers a shattered vessel leaking Wrath, | battling the urge to lash out against his brethren as violent impulses threaten to consume him.

Eremon, a penitent exiled for forbidden love, returns to the cloister seeking forgiveness, but discovers his beloved's emotion imprisoned in a glass jar, | driving him to debate stealing the reliquary and risking the wrath of the Order’s vengeful abbot.

Aspiring swordsman Elias must duel his arrogant rival at the Virescent Academy, knowing that each clash permanently scrambles their most cherished memories, | as he realizes the only way to restore his dying father’s recollection is to strip away victories from his own mind.

Haunted by a violent childhood, Danton enters the elite academy’s midnight tournament, where each defeat rewrites fragments of his past with unexpected trauma, | hoping his next match will erase the mysterious act that put his brother in prison.

At a clandestine academy built atop ancient ruins, Ronan faces his forbidden lover in the ceremonial arena, every landed blow rewriting years of sexual awakening and betrayal, | as they both risk losing the parts of themselves that first kindled their passion.

A grieving train conductor named Markus accidentally boards a spectral subway beneath the city, discovering it ferries restless spirits desperate for a second chance among the living, | but he must choose between aiding a vengeful ghost or saving his own soul before dawn breaks.

Desmond, a washed-up exorcist, is coerced onto an underground railway where failed spirits barter memories for passage back topside, | forcing him to confront guilt over the wife he failed to save as she approaches him from the next car.

After a botched heist kills him, petty thief Leo awakens on the ghostly midnight line routing souls who missed judgment, | but when his long-dead father boards desperate for revenge, Leo must either protect the living or join his father’s vendetta.

Assigned to repair the failing telescopes at an isolated desert observatory, astrophysicist Rami begins seeing new patterns in the night sky that seem to shift whenever he looks away, | driving him to question whether he’s being observed in return—or hunted by something above.

After his brother’s mysterious disappearance during a meteor shower, Khalid spends sleepless nights tracing unfamiliar constellations whose starlight pulses with coded warnings, | while anonymous voice messages hint the stars themselves demand sacrifices for cosmic knowledge.

Obsessed with mapping the sky’s hidden secrets, veteran astronomer Ian gradually realizes that unfamiliar constellations blink in synchrony with his own failing heartbeats, | leaving him with a chilling choice between uncovering the truth or risking his sanity and life for celestial understanding.

When grief from his ex-wife’s death spreads a heavy malaise across his lunar colony, station therapist Ezra battles rising, crushing gravity while hiding his own despair, | knowing a single emotional slip could endanger the oxygen-hungry children growing up in the lower dorms.

Tasked with organizing a lunar independence rally, political strategist Mark watches in dread as tensions spike, making gravity dangerously erratic, | and realizes the colony’s celebrations could collapse into chaos—or a deadly stampede—if he cannot restore calm.

Assigned to investigate a string of suspicious mood manipulations, lunar constable Felix suspects a black market of illegal emotion pills is destabilizing the colony’s gravity, | forcing him to infiltrate a seductive underground club where pleasure and fear threaten to bring the ceiling—literally—crashing down.

In a city governed by miracle-wielding saints and unyielding bureaucrats, a cynical street hustler named Ren ekes out a living selling black market blessings, risking both his soul and his freedom, | as the miracles he peddles begin to unravel in increasingly disastrous and unpredictable ways.

Disgraced ex-saint Gabriel turns to forging miracles for desperate clients after losing his title in a scandal, walking a tightrope between redemption and utter ruin, | especially when the city’s most zealous Inquisitor takes a personal interest in his sudden, unnatural successes.

When underpaid city clerk Milo is coerced into trafficking counterfeit holy relics by a seductive black market boss, he must balance ambition and conscience, | knowing exposure could mean execution or, far worse, supernatural retribution from the vengeful real saints.

When reclusive historian Jonah enters the newly restored Marrow Hill Library to research a serial killer's memoir, he realizes the pages are warping his own reality, | as he finds himself pursued by shadows echoing his darkest childhood traumas inside the maze of shifting bookstacks.

Aspiring novelist Marc is coerced by a secret society to spend the night cataloguing ancient, forbidden manuscripts in the infamous Blackwell Library, | where the books claw him into erotic horrors drawn from the twisted tales he tries hardest to forget.

Disgraced journalist Finn seeks refuge among dusty tomes at the secluded Greystone Library, haunted by rumors of patrons vanishing within its labyrinth, | until the stories begin bleeding into his life, and he is stalked by a figure out of the war crime reports he once fabricated.

Exiled for his father's insurrection, scion prince Taris must survive the monarchy’s baptism—a week in the Abyssal Trench, where vengeful sea spirits hunt trespassers | as rival nobles sabotage his oxygen supply and conspire to erase his bloodline forever.

After being framed for sacrilege against the Tide Queen, palace guard Iven faces forced communion: barefoot and unarmed in a whalefall crypt swarming with bone-pickers, | while the monarch’s predatory consort stalks him below, promising citizenship through death or madness.

Having secretly fallen for a land-dwelling man, crown prince Orris volunteers for a perilous communion beneath the kelp-choked ruins, | desperate to survive the ancient eels’ rites and claim citizenship, unaware his lover is sent below to sabotage him.

When renegade dream-pilot Cassian repeatedly enters citizens’ fevered nightmares to deliver forbidden love letters they are too afraid to send, he’s pursued by agents who police the subconscious, | each flight forcing him to choose between exposing his own unresolved secrets or sacrificing the memories of those he serves.

Hunted by a syndicate that profits from controlling dream communication, ex-military pilot Jonas crash-lands nightly into violent storm-realms conjured by the guilt of the sleeping elite, | the next delivery promising him a clue about the missing brother he lost both in war and in dreams.

As storm courier Ray navigates surreal, ever-shifting landscapes rife with psychic tempests to smuggle seditious manifestos to rebels, his latest client—a shadowy woman—demands a message hand-delivered into a nightmare from which no one returns, | threatening to unravel both his sanity and his tightly kept secret past.

When the reclusive tailor Aron is blamed for a griffin's madness after stitching an experimental protection spell into its wings, he must clear his name before the terrified villagers turn on him, | even as the afflicted beast starts haunting his dreams.

As apprentice seamster Baren becomes the first male ever admitted to the coven of beast-cloth artisans, petty rivalries escalate after his enchanted garments make a notoriously violent wyvern fall eerily tame, | provoking whispers of sabotage and forbidden love amidst the needle-lit cottage rows.

After his lover is slain by a corrupted manticore that wore his handiwork, young craftsman Joss vows revenge by weaving dangerously volatile hexes into the next commission, | knowing the village elders will exile or execute him if his true intentions are discovered.

In the rain-soaked alleys of District Neon, a memory-dealing hustler named Kade is blackmailed into stealing the childhood recollections of a notorious crime boss, risking his life as digital enforcers tighten their surveillance | while he starts to experience unsettling fragments of other people’s pasts as his own.

Tek, a down-on-his-luck mechanic, is accused of pirating memories after waking up with vivid visions that don’t belong to him, as shadowy corporate agents hunt him through neon-lit slums | and he races to find the original memory’s owner before his mind unravels completely.

When Joakim, a grief-stricken widower, downloads his late wife’s final moments from the black market to relive their last night together, illegal memory censors begin to close in, | threatening not just his freedom but the only traces of her he has left.

Gideon, a burned-out historian, finds himself trapped inside the labyrinthine portal station while chasing a shadowy saboteur intent on dooming every door’s era to collapse, | the fate of a fractured civilization reflected in the flickering screens and haunted eyes of travelers from centuries apart.

Cynical station engineer Marcus must repair the door to his own childhood era before the encroaching cataclysm sweeps through, | all while dodging desperate refugees who want to escape fate by rewriting their brutal pasts and futures.

A guilt-ridden detective named Jonas tracks his dead lover’s killer through doors leading to his civilization’s golden age and inevitable downfall, | the clues growing more disturbing as each portal reveals new betrayals and fresh bodies in a world forever spiraling toward ruin.

Exiled logger Gideon stumbles into a mystical tribunal deep within the moonlit pines, where vengeful woodland animals demand justice for a scorched grove, | while his past sins resurface in vivid illusions conjured by a cunning fox, driving him toward madness.

Hunted for his timber poaching, Marcus is captured by militant crows and dragged before a council of ancient stags, who accuse him of breaking sacred pacts, | and he must barter his own memories in exchange for even a chance at mercy from the furred assembly.

Alone and drunk, Owen lights a forbidden fire near a fawn’s grave, awakening a silent jury of wolves and owls who bind him in vines, | leaving his fate in the claws of a lynx who lost her mate to his carelessness years ago.

When reclusive poet Julian recites forgotten verses during a midnight reading, reality around the city begins to warp and fracture, | drawing the attention of a ruthless cult bent on harnessing his linguistic power for their own apocalyptic ends.

Struggling with grief after his sister vanishes, Caleb discovers an ancient tongue that can bend truth and memory, transforming everything he says, | but each verse spoken erases a piece of his own past, threatening to obliterate who he once was.

Haunted by visions in his dreams, Mikhail uncovers an eldritch book of poetry buried beneath the abandoned opera house, | yet every stanza he voices awakens fleshly horrors that hunger for both pleasure and pain in the waking world.

After watching his family perish in a city bombing, orphaned 15-year-old Luka is whisked away by shadowy strangers to the remote mountain fortress of Astrafor, where children duel by commanding sentient star patterns, | as he struggles to trust his enigmatic trainer whose motives may not be as noble as they seem.

Determined to avenge his parents, war orphan Elias infiltrates a secret underground academy hidden beneath the ruins of his hometown, where the students wield living constellations as weapons, | soon realizing that the dazzling celestial allies feeding on his grief could one day consume his sanity.

Haunted by nightmares of burning villages, scarred teenager Misha finds himself conscripted into an elite corps at the clandestine Umbranox Academy, forced to master constellations that reflect his darkest desires, | while rival students manipulate him into unleashing the forbidden ‘Serpent Star’ in a deadly rite of passage.

Newly widowed concert violinist Lucien is drawn nightly to the abandoned theater where his wife's spirit haunts the stage, his grief shaping melodies that summon alternate versions of her from parallel worlds, | each conversation forcing him to confront impossible choices, including a version of himself who chose vengeance over love.

Haunted by the loss of his estranged father, virtuoso violinist Mateo performs in shadowy underground clubs hoping to sense forgiveness, but every performance opens a portal to a different father—each hiding dangerous secrets, | and one night, an encounter leaves Mateo holding a bloodstained letter that was never meant for him.

Once acclaimed but now lost in sorrow after the death of his lover, violinist Soren busks beneath city bridges, his aching notes conjuring lovers from universes where betrayals unfolded differently, | until an older, bitter Soren steps from the abyss, desperate to silence him before the truth escapes their music.

When Quinn, the village smith’s son, is paired with the storm pattern and blamed for every disaster, he must prove he’s not fated for ruin | while a mysterious drought threatens the crops and his family faces wrathful suspicion from everyone he’s ever known.

Joren is marked by relentless drizzle at birth and dismissed as mediocrity incarnate, but after secretly falling for the chieftain’s wild daughter destined for sun and fire, | he risks exile and heartbreak by trying to change his predetermined weather and fate for love’s sake.

Assigned the brutal blizzard at birth, Aldric grows into a feared enforcer who secretly craves gentleness, yet finds himself drawn to a forbidden spring-born rival, | his inner turmoil reaching a breaking point as the village elders plot to force the pair into a deadly public duel.

Captain Declan, haunted by the memory of his lost brother, commands a ragtag skyship as they chase rumors of an eclipse island that grants wishes, | but mutiny brews below decks when the crew uncovers the true cost of the island’s legendary magic.

Bitter and vengeful after a devastating betrayal, cloud-pirate Jacen obsesses over a map inked on his skin that glows only during eclipses, | while the seductive and dangerous first mate threatens to reveal his secret to imperial bounty hunters in exchange for freedom.

Stranded above a roiling sea of clouds, First Mate Ash must defy his cruel captain when the crew kidnaps a mysterious woman who claims to summon eclipse islands, | as a deadly aerial navy closes in and the woman's powers begin to violently warp reality aboard the skyship.

Brother Hal, a failed seminarian now caretaker at the android convent, develops an obsession with the enigmatic Sister-Unit Amara after witnessing her nightly rituals, | leading him to risk excommunication as he follows cryptic code fragments that promise redemption to the forsaken.

Tormented by memories he can’t erase, ex-detective Jonas infiltrates the cloister of android nuns to repair his broken sense of self, | soon unraveling a conspiracy when he discovers their newest sister defies canon law with subversive prayers that heal the mind.

Struggling with guilt over surviving a mining disaster his friends did not, laborer Cal seeks solace in a remote mountainside monastery maintained by android clergy, | but his devotion falters as a rebellious nun’s forbidden prayers begin rewriting his deepest traumas and blurring the line between man and machine.

Marooned in the infamous Witherwood after his brother’s disappearance, Elias risks taking the winding eastward path, | where he encounters his ancestor as a tyrannical baron who demands Elias betray his own bloodline to survive.

Lost during a desperate search for a cure to his daughter’s mysterious illness, forester Jace stumbles into a fog-shrouded trail, | greeted by a 19th-century version of his family who are fleeing a violent witch-hunt that mirrors current-day accusations in his own life.

Tracking the footsteps of a fugitive uncle, young widower Braam enters a mossy tunnel between twisted oaks, | arriving amid a medieval battleground where his lineage’s dark secret could rewrite the fate of everyone he’s ever loved.

Prince Lorcan, the royal cartographer, is cursed to map the elusive continent of Veridia that vanishes each time he utters an honest word to his suspicious bodyguard, | their mutual distrust growing as the truth repeatedly shifts their destination and puts their loyalty on trial.

Tasked with charting a continent that slips away whenever truth is spoken, the disgraced navigator Alaric must conceal both his forbidden love affair with the king’s son and the real borders he discovers, | as political enemies close in, threatening exile or execution if he is unmasked.

On a continent whose location spirals chaotically with every revealed secret, obsessive perfectionist Gareth must guide a spiteful royal delegation through ever-changing wilds, | while fending off assassination attempts from those who would kill to keep the land’s true position forever hidden.

Disguised as a servant in the decadent city of Valrous, teen thief Marek risks his life sneaking into noble estates to harvest their shadows, | attracting the attention of a vindictive duke who suspects the empty darkness plaguing his mansion is Marek’s doing.

Haunted by his own invisible past, seventeen-year-old Lio makes a living selling stolen noble shadows to outcasts afraid of being exposed, | until he accidentally sells a shadow bound to a vengeful spirit that threatens to drag him and his clients into ruin.

Tasked to steal the untouched shadow of the crown prince during a masked ball, young thief Corin faces treacherous courtiers and forbidden magic, | especially when the prince’s lover secretly offers Corin her body in exchange for keeping the prince alive another night.

Haunted by the extinction of his home planet, former starship engineer Milo takes a job at the Celestial Terminus Hotel, where he’s tasked with escorting the last guests from evaporating worlds, | as he’s forced to confront the ghosts of his own lost civilization when a familiar visitor checks in.

When gambler-turned-concierge Kellan is offered the chance to win back his freedom by serving doomed travelers their final wishes, temptation gnaws at him, | as a notorious warlord from a feared obliterated species checks in and demands an impossible favor before dawn.

A disgraced cosmic diplomat named Theo is assigned to welcome guests from societies facing annihilation, desperately hoping for redemption by convincing one guest to forgive him, | but the arrival of an embittered ex-lover, whose planet falls next, rekindles dangerous old passions and regrets.

Isolated widower Calvin begins to suspect his locked guest room leads somewhere else after nightly dreams of an unfamiliar family and neon city, | while rumors swirl of townsfolk vanishing from their beds during electrical storms.

Local bartender Mason finds a bloodstained uniform in his closet from a parallel war-torn world where he’s a deserter, | and must decide whether to risk his life to save his double’s lover, who appears begging for sanctuary.

After losing custody of his daughter, frustrated mechanic Jay stumbles into a garage where his parallel self is a ruthless criminal, | tempting Jay to swap places and reclaim his child—if he’s willing to embrace the darkness inside him.

Struggling to let go of his mother's drowning, night ferry pilot Luca makes a habit of secretly swapping passengers' regrets for his own as he rows them across the river, | until one evening a mysterious stowaway insists on trading a memory he desperately refuses to lose.

Haunted by recurring dreams of a lover he betrayed, embittered chef Matteo starts taking the midnight regret-ferry, hoping the next crossing will erase the shame that keeps him awake, | but each journey returns a new, harrowing twist to his love story that he can't easily explain away.

After years of using the ferry to dull the traumatic memories of childhood abuse, ex-convict Danilo is confronted by a spectral ferryman who demands payment in lost truths, | forcing him to choose between uncovering repressed horrors or surrendering what little identity remains to the moonlit tide.

When border guard Mateo discovers that his secret, invisible role in the hidden society is a notorious thief wanted by both worlds, his double life becomes dangerously unstable | as a relentless investigator closes in, threatening exposure of the entire border town’s clandestine existence.

While tending his late mother’s inn near the border, Tomas finds his invisible occupation makes him the hidden society’s assassin, torn between his public kindness and violent secret duties | after he’s tasked to eliminate the town’s beloved priest, forcing Tomas to question his loyalties.

Haunted by the nightly whispers of an unseen brotherhood, Lázaro must smuggle forbidden relics across the border for his shadow occupation, risking his family’s safety | when rival factions offer brutal choices: betray his childhood friend or see his sister taken as collateral.

Asher, a skilled orphaned mapmaker in a fractured empire, uncovers a hidden continent that exists solely on war maps drawn by enemy kingdoms, | compelling him to choose between the lies of the victors and the dangerous truths hiding beneath his ink-stained hands.

Haunted by his parents’ mysterious disappearance, Lucien survives by forging maps until he stumbles across secret charts showing a continent he cannot find anywhere in reality, | driving him into a shadowy game of espionage between rival cartographers determined to erase all traces of this land—including him.

While toiling in the archives of a xenophobic nation, itinerant orphan mapmaker Selwyn realizes the newly charted continent shapes itself differently depending on which bordering country draws it, | pushing him toward a forbidden love and a perilous journey across enemy lines as governments close in with accusations of treason.

A reclusive vintner named Luca inherits his grandfather's vineyard, where the wine's supernatural property threatens to unravel the lies that have held his fractured family together for decades, | as his estranged brother demands a tasting at the next family reunion.

Nico, a disgraced sommelier seeking redemption after a public scandal, takes a night job at a remote Italian vineyard rumored to expose the true age of secrets, | and is blackmailed by a local crime lord desperate to conceal a decades-old murder.

Struggling winemaker Marco hosts clandestine midnight tastings for influential townsfolk to revive his business, but tempers erupt when the enchanted wine reveals the duration of a forbidden affair, | pushing him perilously close to betraying his own darkest secret.

Known for his uncanny skill at deciphering bloodstains and fabric distress, forensic tailor Marcus Vale is called to investigate a celebrated actress’s murder when her gown is found torn at a high-society gala, | forcing him to confront the criminal underbelly of the fashion industry while hiding his own sordid past.

Hired by a grieving father after his son’s mysterious death, veteran forensic tailor Hugo Grisham reconstructs the victim’s last moments from a shredded designer suit, | unraveling a political scandal that powerful figures in the city will do anything to suppress.

Summoned by the police to examine a set of burned clothes linked to a series of secretive club murders, ex-con tailor Dean Russo must use his unique skills to clear his own name, | even as the signature scorch marks evoke dark memories of his own time behind bars.

When court minstrel Fenn accidentally composes the coronation ballad that crowns him king, he is forced to rewrite the kingdom’s dark past to quell unrest, | yet each secret lyric he changes returns to haunt him as vengeful ghosts rise with every new verse.

Aspiring bard-turned-contender Jorel struggles for his place when the dying ruler chooses his song as the royal succession rite, | but old nobles threaten civil war unless Jorel erases the song that exposes their centuries-old crimes.

Exiled for singing forbidden verses, Marek returns when the queen dies without a chosen heir, sparking panic among rival musicians vying for the throne, | while Marek battles his own conscience over whether his ballad should preserve painful truths or offer comforting lies.

After his home is destroyed in the shadow of the sleeping giant, a widowed refugee named Larek struggles to protect his daughter from nightly storms birthed by the titan’s nightmares, | finding himself torn between reverence for the giant and a growing desperation to survive the camp’s wild tempests.

When Malik, a traumatized war survivor, joins a secretive group within the refugee camp that vows to wake the giant and end the dream disasters, he’s haunted by visions of his deceased brother, | each vision becoming more real as the weather turns deadlier with every day the giant sleeps.

Hired as the camp’s new weather-watcher, Aris suspects the camp leader is feeding the giant’s subconscious with stories of old atrocities to weaponize its dreams, | but exposing this conspiracy could spark violence in a community already fraying under relentless floods and unending lightning strikes.
